lines.text: 不同地区会产出不同材料
两件一样的家伙，拿起一件往另一件上一压，就成一件好的

texts.en: Take two of the same and press one onto the other. They become one better piece.

lines.text: 歇脚的地方有砧子，一把家伙配一块对路的料，敲一下就上一档

texts.en: Where you rest there's an anvil. One weapon, one right piece of stock, one strike, one grade up.

lines.text: 料越好，打出来的越好，别心疼好料

texts.en: Better stock, better work. Don't hoard the good stuff.

lines.text: 矿石先炼成锭，再谈打东西

texts.en: Ore gets smelted into ingots first. Then we talk.

lines.text: 我只动你库里的料，上了锁的不碰；打好的也放回库里

texts.en: I only use stock from your storehouse, never anything locked. The work goes back there too.
